grades.quote: During the execution of a floating-point instruction, multiple floating-point exceptions can be generated at the same time.
grades.reason: Acknowledges that multiple floating-point exceptions can occur at once. It says each one is recorded in the FCSR0 Cause field and that the Enable bits decide whether a trap is taken. It does not give any priority rule for choosing a single reported exception, so it only helps in a limited way.
Describes only the overflow exception. It notes that overflow also sets inexact, but it gives no rule for selecting which exception is reported when several apply.
Covers how cycle and instret counters behave across privilege modes. It does not cover how a reported exception is chosen when several are possible.
Describes the vcompress instruction and its restrictions. It says nothing about priority among multiple possible exceptions.
